WITH comp AS (SELECT id, name FROM companies WHERE name IN ('Castelo da Diversão','Mega Magic','Planeta Divertido','Aventura Kids','Buffet Aventura Kids') OR id IN (SELECT DISTINCT company_id FROM wapi_conversations WHERE last_message_at > now() - interval '30 days'))
SELECT json_build_object(
  'conversas', (SELECT json_agg(x) FROM (
    SELECT c.name AS empresa,
      count(*) AS total,
      count(*) FILTER (WHERE w.last_message_at > now() - interval '30 days') AS ativas_30d,
      count(*) FILTER (WHERE w.last_message_at > now() - interval '7 days') AS ativas_7d,
      count(*) FILTER (WHERE coalesce(w.unread_count,0) > 0) AS com_nao_lidas,
      count(*) FILTER (WHERE coalesce(w.unread_count,0) > 0 AND w.last_message_at < now() - interval '7 days') AS nao_lidas_velhas,
      count(*) FILTER (WHERE w.is_closed) AS fechadas,
      count(*) FILTER (WHERE w.is_favorite) AS favoritas,
      count(*) FILTER (WHERE w.is_equipe) AS equipe,
      count(*) FILTER (WHERE w.is_freelancer) AS freelancer,
      count(*) FILTER (WHERE w.remote_jid LIKE '%@g.us') AS grupos,
      count(*) FILTER (WHERE w.lead_id IS NOT NULL) AS com_lead,
      count(*) FILTER (WHERE w.lead_id IS NULL AND w.remote_jid NOT LIKE '%@g.us' AND NOT w.is_equipe AND NOT w.is_freelancer AND w.last_message_at > now() - interval '30 days') AS sem_lead_30d,
      count(*) FILTER (WHERE w.pinned_message_id IS NOT NULL) AS com_fixada,
      count(*) FILTER (WHERE w.bot_enabled) AS robo_ligado,
      count(DISTINCT w.instance_id) AS numeros
    FROM wapi_conversations w JOIN comp c ON c.id = w.company_id GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY count(*) DESC) x),
  'leads', (SELECT json_agg(x) FROM (
    SELECT c.name AS empresa, count(*) AS total,
      count(*) FILTER (WHERE l.created_at > now() - interval '30 days') AS novos_30d,
      count(*) FILTER (WHERE l.responsavel_id IS NULL) AS sem_responsavel,
      count(*) FILTER (WHERE l.unit IS NULL) AS sem_unidade,
      count(*) FILTER (WHERE l.return_count > 0) AS voltaram,
      count(*) FILTER (WHERE l.observacoes IS NOT NULL AND l.observacoes <> '') AS com_obs
    FROM campaign_leads l JOIN comp c ON c.id = l.company_id GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY count(*) DESC) x),
  'status', (SELECT json_agg(x) FROM (
    SELECT c.name AS empresa, l.status, count(*) n FROM campaign_leads l JOIN comp c ON c.id = l.company_id GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1, 3 DESC) x),
  'acoes_30d', (SELECT json_agg(x) FROM (
    SELECT c.name AS empresa, h.action, count(*) n, count(*) FILTER (WHERE h.user_id IS NULL) AS sistema
    FROM lead_history h JOIN comp c ON c.id = h.company_id WHERE h.created_at > now() - interval '30 days' GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1, 3 DESC) x),
  'mensagens_7d', (SELECT json_agg(x) FROM (
    SELECT c.name AS empresa, count(*) AS total, count(*) FILTER (WHERE m.from_me) AS enviadas, count(*) FILTER (WHERE m.is_starred) AS estrela,
      count(*) FILTER (WHERE m.message_type <> 'text') AS midia
    FROM wapi_messages m JOIN comp c ON c.id = m.company_id WHERE m.created_at > now() - interval '7 days' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC) x),
  'usuarios', (SELECT json_agg(x) FROM (
    SELECT c.name AS empresa, count(DISTINCT uc.user_id) AS pessoas FROM user_companies uc JOIN comp c ON c.id = uc.company_id GROUP BY 1) x)
) AS r
